notes.cohort: 31 triplets / 93 questions (counterfactuals v6 FROZEN_SELECTION_ok31); recovery for the 62 Q1/Q2 questions
notes.LD: log p(r) - log p(r'), teacher forced, r = clean answer, r' = counterfactual answer
notes.recovery: denoise = (LD - LD_cf)/(LD_clean - LD_cf) with CF tokens and the clean run's path patched in; noise = (LD_clean - LD)/(LD_clean - LD_cf) with clean tokens and the CF run's path patched in
notes.kinds: gdn: GDN recurrent state + short-conv buffers; gdn_state_only: state only; attn: softmax K/V at the changed positions; both: gdn + attn (recovery 1 by construction, checked)
notes.triplet: median of the triplet's Q1 and Q2
notes.otherFact: Q3 has r == r' (LD = 0); delta = log p(r) of the patched row minus its receiver run (denoise: CF run, noise: clean run)
